hook.name: CoinbarrelAdvancedHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing custom fee accounting for Coinbarrel Advanced V3 pools. It intercepts swaps to collect configurable buy/sell fees via BeforeSwapDelta (input-side) and afterSwapReturnDelta (output-side), minting fee tokens to itself rather than transferring during swaps, while recording per-pool TWAP and organic volume observations.
